name: RetroArch
latestVersionSource: GET https://buildbot.libretro.com/stable/ -> regex href="/stable/(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/" -> semver max; or GitHub API libretro/RetroArch releases/latest tag_name (v1.22.2)
notes: Portable by default on Windows (retroarch.cfg lives next to retroarch.exe). Verified: 1.22.2 is latest stable (2025-11-20), RetroArch.7z = 202,509,078 bytes. Nightly: https://buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/windows/x86_64/RetroArch.7z. Cores: https://buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/windows/x86_64/latest/{core}_libretro.dll.zip (zip contains only {core}_libretro.dll at root). Stable core bundle (all cores, 230MB): https://buildbot.libretro.com/stable/{version}/windows/x86_64/RetroArch_cores.7z. Core index with dates+CRC: https://buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/windows/x86_64/latest/.index-extended

name: Dolphin
latestVersionSource: GET https://dolphin-emu.org/update/latest/beta/ -> JSON {shortrev, artifacts:[{system:'Windows x64', url}]} (the 'beta' track = numbered releases, currently 2609)
notes: Verified archive layout via 7z header: Dolphin-x64/Dolphin.exe (+DolphinTool.exe, Updater.exe). -b = batch (exit when emulation stops), -e = exec, -C System.Section.Key=Value overrides config, -u <dir> sets user dir. portable.txt must sit next to Dolphin.exe (creates User/ there). Needs VC++ 2015-2022 x64 redist.

name: PCSX2
notes: Verified flags in pcsx2-qt/QtHost.cpp: -batch, -nogui, -fullscreen, -nofullscreen, -bigpicture, -fastboot, -slowboot, -state <n>, -statefile <f>, -elf, -disc, -bios, -logfile, -portable. exe at archive root (verified). Requires user-supplied PS2 BIOS in <root>/bios/. Avoid the -symbols.7z and installer.exe assets.

name: RPCS3
latestVersionSource: GitHub API RPCS3/rpcs3-binaries-win releases/latest (tag build-<sha>, e.g. rpcs3-v0.0.43-20204-c673da45_win64_msvc.7z on 2026-10-03). Do NOT use /releases list ordering (not chronological).
notes: Verified flags (rpcs3/rpcs3.cpp): --no-gui, --fullscreen (only with --no-gui), --headless, --installfw <PUP>, --installpkg <pkg>, --config, --savestate. {rom} = path to EBOOT.BIN, game folder, or ISO. Always portable on Windows (config/dev_hdd0 next to exe). Requires PS3UPDAT.PUP firmware (rpcs3.exe --installfw) and VC++ 2015-2022 x64 redist. Skip the .sha256 asset.

name: Eden
latestVersionSource: Forgejo API GET https://git.eden-emu.dev/api/v1/repos/eden-emu/eden/releases?limit=1 -> [0].assets[].browser_download_url (GitHub mirror eden-emulator/Releases is DMCA-blocked)
notes: Verified in src/core/launch_params.cpp: -f/--fullscreen, -g/--game <path>, -u/--user, -c/--config. Portable mode = a directory named 'user' next to eden.exe (PORTABLE_DIR). Faster variant: Eden-Windows-v*-amd64-clang-pgo.zip. Requires user-dumped prod.keys (user/keys/) + firmware. Alternatives (Citron, Ryujinx/Ryubing) checked: Citron last Windows build 2026-04, Ryubing host unreachable; Eden is the active pick.

name: Azahar
notes: Exe is inside a versioned subfolder; search for azahar.exe after extracting. WARNING: zip entries use backslash separators (azahar-windows-msvc-2126.1.2\azahar.exe) - 7za handles it; some JS unzip libs create literal-backslash filenames. Verified flags: -f/--fullscreen, -i/--install <cia>, -g is GDB port (not game). Portable = 'user' dir next to exe. Requires decrypted ROMs. azahar_libretro core also on buildbot.

name: Cemu
latestVersionSource: GitHub API releases/latest (v2.6, 2025-02-06 - still latest stable)
notes: Verified archive layout: Cemu_2.6/Cemu.exe. Verified flags (LaunchSettings.cpp): -g/--game <path>, -t/--title-id, -f/--fullscreen, -m/--mlc. Portable = directory 'portable' next to Cemu.exe. Needs VC++ redist.

name: xemu
latestVersionSource: GitHub API releases/latest (v0.8.136). Stable alias asset xemu-win-x86_64-release.zip always present on latest; the 'pre-release' tag is a rolling nightly.
notes: Verified: archive = xemu.exe + LICENSE.txt. -dvd_path parsed in system/vl.c, -full-screen is the QEMU option. Portable mode: xemu.toml present next to xemu.exe (ui/xemu-settings.cc). Required: mcpx_1.0.bin (md5 d49c52a4102f6df7bcf8d0617ac475ed), flash BIOS (Complex 4627 modded/debug), HDD image (https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu-dashboard/releases/latest/download/xbox_hdd.qcow2). Paths are set in xemu.toml [sys.files] bootrom_path/flashrom_path/hdd_path.

name: Vita3K

notes: Verified (config.cpp): -F/--fullscreen, -r/--installed-path <TitleID>, positional content-path (.vpk/.zip installs & runs), --pkg <f> --zrif <key>, --firmware <PUP>, -c/--config-location. name: PPSSPP
notes: Portable by DEFAULT: data goes to memstick/ next to exe unless installed.txt exists (then Documents/PPSSPP) - never create installed.txt.
